effects.what: the fragile gear rode it out

options.label: Pack the fragile gear in the suitcase
options.outcome: The radio, mask and flashlight ride it out in the suitcase.

options.label: Get under the table
options.outcome: Everyone is fine. The shelf is less fine.

options.label: Hold the shelves steady
options.outcome: {name} braces the shelf with both arms until the shaking stops.

aftershock.setup: A long aftershock rolls through the shelter. Shelves sway. Something glass is thinking about it.
aftershock.title: The Ground Shrugs

options.label: Signal from the hatch
options.outcome: The searchlight stops on the hatch, and stays.

options.label: Flash a mirror at it
options.outcome: {name} angles the bathroom mirror at the sky and hopes.

options.label: Stay below
options.outcome: The searchlight moves on to the next street.

airlift_1_retry.setup: The helicopter is back, lower than before, searchlight sweeping the gardens.
airlift_1_retry.title: Rotor Noise, Lower

options.label: Signal from the hatch
options.outcome: The helicopter dips once. Someone up there saw.

options.label: Climb out and wave
options.outcome: {name} waves both arms in the dust until the noise fades.

options.label: Stay below
options.outcome: The rotor noise fades toward the river.

airlift_1_rotor.setup: A helicopter is sweeping the neighbourhood at dusk, low and slow, as if counting roofs.
airlift_1_rotor.title: Rotor Noise

effects.what: marked the roof through the dust

options.label: Go up masked and lay out every sheet
options.outcome: Every sheet in the shelter, pegged down with tins. Very visible.

options.label: Shine a light up from the yard
options.outcome: A beam straight up, all night. They'll see that.

options.label: Leave it
options.outcome: The roof stays grey.

airlift_2_retry.setup: A second canister: "Couldn't see your roof. Try again tonight, bigger."
airlift_2_retry.title: Mark It Again

effects.what: marked the roof through the dust

options.label: Go up masked and lay out sheets
options.outcome: A white cross on a grey roof. It looks like a request.

options.label: Go up without a mask
options.outcome: The cross is laid. {name} coughs for an hour afterwards.

options.label: Leave the roof as it is
options.outcome: The helicopter passes over a roof like every other roof.

airlift_2_roof.setup: A dropped canister holds a note: mark your roof with something white tonight. The roof is thick with dust.
airlift_2_roof.title: Mark the Roof

options.label: Pick a clear spot on the map
options.outcome: A school field, two streets over. They signal agreement.

options.label: Send someone to look
options.outcome: {name} walks the blocks for a flat, open space and comes back grey with dust.

options.label: Don't answer
options.outcome: They circle twice and leave.

airlift_3_lz.setup: A loudhailer from above: they need a clear landing spot within a few streets.
airlift_3_lz.title: Landing Zone

options.label: Find a car park on the map
options.outcome: A supermarket car park, empty for once. They agree.

options.label: Walk the streets and look
options.outcome: {name} paces out an intersection and waves at the sky.

options.label: Don't answer
options.outcome: They circle once and fly on.

airlift_3_retry.setup: "The field was blocked. We need another clear spot. Anywhere flat."
airlift_3_retry.title: Somewhere to Land

options.label: Run for it
options.outcome: Hands pull everyone aboard. The street drops away.

else.text: The crew can't wait. The helicopter lifts off without you.

options.label: Wait for everyone to gather their things
options.outcome: The crew chief taps her watch.

airlift_4_lift.setup: At first light the helicopter settles in the street. The crew waves everyone over, fast.
airlift_4_lift.title: Lift

options.label: Run for it
options.outcome: Everyone is pulled aboard, bags and all. Nobody looks back for long.

options.label: Stay
options.outcome: The noise fades, then the silence settles back in.

airlift_4_retry.setup: The helicopter settles again, rotor turning. "This is the last flight out of this area."
airlift_4_retry.title: One More Pass

bad_air.omen: Headaches all round this morning. The air in the shelter feels thick.

options.label: Go up masked and clear the vent
options.outcome: Ash had packed the vent solid. Fresh air, and a lot of coughing.

options.label: Open the hatch for an hour
options.outcome: Cold air pours in. So does the dust, and possibly attention.

then.cause: The air in the shelter went bad overnight.

options.label: Lie down and wait for it to pass
options.outcome: Everyone lies down. The headaches get worse before they get better.

bad_air.setup: Everyone is dizzy. The air has gone stale and heavy, and the candle flame keeps shrinking.
bad_air.title: Bad Air

effects.what: kept the rain-out out of the vent

options.label: Go up masked and cover the vent
options.outcome: The vent is covered. Outside is dangerous again for a couple of days.

options.label: Tape the vent from inside
options.outcome: Tape, towels, and a long night listening to the counter. Trips will be dangerous for a while.

options.label: Catch it in the barrel anyway
options.outcome: A barrel of grey water. Nobody is quite sure it was worth it.

black_rain.setup: It rains for the first time since the flash. The rain is dark, and the Geiger counter starts clicking again.
black_rain.title: Black Rain

options.label: Give him a tour
options.outcome: He eats a ration "for the content." Everyone feels oddly famous.

options.label: Tell him the truth
options.outcome: He sits on the hatch a long while, then leaves the ring light behind.

options.label: Play him for his gear
options.outcome: You win his respirator. He takes it well, for a streamer.

bunker_tour.setup: A man in a hazmat suit with a ring light is livestreaming "Day 6". Nobody has told him the internet is gone.
bunker_tour.title: Bunker Tour

options.label: Run a tournament
options.outcome: The finals are tense. Nobody remembers the smell.

options.label: Call a family meeting
options.outcome: You have accidentally founded an HOA.

options.label: Let it burn out
options.outcome: It does, eventually. {subject} refuses tomorrow's trip on principle.

cabin_fever.setup: The argument about whose fault the smell is has reached its third hour.
cabin_fever.title: Cabin Fever

options.label: Crank the radio and answer
options.outcome: A tired dispatcher takes the family's names. "Keep this channel. We'll call back."

then.text: The van stopped. Someone wrote the address down.

options.label: Shout up through the vent
options.outcome: {name} shouts until their voice gives out.

options.label: Stay quiet
options.outcome: The van moves on. The street goes quiet again.

convoy_1_contact.setup: A loudspeaker van crawls past overhead: "Survivors, tune to channel four on the hour."
convoy_1_contact.title: Channel Four

options.label: Crank the radio and answer
options.outcome: "Got you this time." The dispatcher sounds relieved, or tired.

options.label: Run up and flag the van down
options.outcome: {name} chases the van down the street, waving.

options.label: Let it go
options.outcome: The van turns the corner and doesn't come back.

convoy_1_retry.setup: The loudspeaker van is back, slower this time. "Last call for channel four. On the hour."
convoy_1_retry.title: Channel Four, Again

options.label: Answer on the radio
options.outcome: "There you are. You're on the list."

options.label: Flash the house number at the street
options.outcome: Long, short, long, at every passing engine.

options.label: Miss it
options.outcome: The roll call ends. The names keep going on without yours.

convoy_2_retry.setup: The dispatcher is reading the roll call one more time, slowly, for anyone who missed it.
convoy_2_retry.title: Roll Call, Last Names

options.label: Answer the roll call
options.outcome: "Got you. Sit tight." The channel goes back to static.

options.label: Bang on the pipes in case
options.outcome: The pipes ring all afternoon. Hard to say who's listening.

options.label: Let the hour pass
options.outcome: The hour passes.

convoy_2_rollcall.setup: Channel four, on the hour. The dispatcher needs a headcount and any medical needs.
convoy_2_rollcall.title: Roll Call

options.label: Read off the grid square
options.outcome: "Square D7. Confirmed." Someone circles it twice.

options.label: Describe the street from memory
options.outcome: She repeats it back slowly. "We'll see what we can do."

options.label: Don't answer
options.outcome: Other families answer. The list moves on.

convoy_3_grid.setup: The dispatcher reads pickup points by grid square. The family has to name the nearest one.
convoy_3_grid.title: Grid Square

options.label: Read the nearest junction off the map
options.outcome: "I know that corner. Pickup confirmed."

options.label: Describe what's out the vent
options.outcome: A fence, a lamp post, a lot of grey. She writes something down.

options.label: Don't answer
options.outcome: Static, then music, then static.

convoy_3_retry.setup: The dispatcher tries again: "Give me anything. A landmark, a street sign, a big tree."
convoy_3_retry.title: Any Landmark

options.label: Signal at midnight
options.outcome: A horn, twice. Somebody saw.

effects.why: a fire in the yard drew attention

options.label: Burn something in the yard
options.outcome: A small, smoky fire. Visible from a long way off, to anyone.

options.label: Sleep through it
options.outcome: Engines at midnight. Then not.

convoy_4_retry.setup: "Trucks will pass again at midnight. If you're there, show us."
convoy_4_retry.title: Second Pass

options.label: Signal at nine sharp
options.outcome: A truck flashes its lights back twice. They know where you are.

options.label: Wave a phone screen
options.outcome: The screen glows for eleven minutes. Then the battery quits.

options.label: Keep the hatch dark
options.outcome: Engines pass at nine. They don't stop.

convoy_4_signal.setup: "At nine tonight, show a light at your door so the trucks can find you."
convoy_4_signal.title: Lights at Nine

options.label: Open the hatch
options.outcome: It's the convoy. A woman with a clipboard checks names and hands out water.

else.text: Nobody answers. Footsteps leave. Engines idle, then go.

options.label: Ask who it is first
options.outcome: {name} calls up through the hatch and waits.

options.label: Keep it shut
options.outcome: The knocking stops. Engines idle, then leave.

convoy_5_knock.setup: Three knocks at the hatch, then three more. No voice. The radio said the convoy would come today.
convoy_5_knock.title: The Knock

options.label: Open the hatch
options.outcome: Hi-vis vests, a clipboard, and a ramp into a truck with seats in it.

options.label: Keep it shut
options.outcome: Boots on gravel, an engine, quiet.

convoy_5_retry.setup: Knocking again, harder. A voice this time: "Convoy. Last stop on this street."
convoy_5_retry.title: The Knock, Again

options.label: Treat it early
options.outcome: Antibiotics, rest and a lot of hot water. It doesn't spread.

else.text: The sheet works. The cough stays behind it and fades.

options.label: Hang a sheet and isolate {subject}
options.outcome: {subject} spends three days behind a hung sheet with a book and a bucket.

options.label: Carry on as normal
options.outcome: It's just a cough, until it isn't.

cough_goes_round.setup: {subject} has a dry cough this morning. By noon, so does the person next to them.
cough_goes_round.title: The Cough Goes Round

effects.what: resealed the vent in the dust

options.label: Go up and reseal it
options.outcome: Ten minutes up the ladder. The cover is taped and the dust stops.

options.label: Tape it from inside
options.outcome: The tape holds, mostly. Everything tastes faintly of chalk.

options.label: Hope the wind changes
options.outcome: The wind doesn't change.

dust_in_the_vent.setup: The air vent cover has cracked. Grey dust is drifting in with every gust.
dust_in_the_vent.title: Dust in the Vent

options.label: Plan a trip before the rest goes
options.outcome: Somebody starts packing. The stores are a third emptier than yesterday.

effects.what: heard which stores still had stock

options.label: Listen for which stores are still open
options.outcome: A volunteer reads out a list. One address still has a back room nobody found.

options.label: Tighten rations instead
options.outcome: Smaller portions, longer evenings. The stores keep emptying anyway.

empty_shelves.setup: Through the vent, a neighbour shouts to another: the stores on the main road were cleared out overnight.
empty_shelves.title: Empty Shelves

options.label: Keep it locked
options.outcome: He tapes a violation notice to it. Fines are now theoretical.

options.label: Treat his cough
options.outcome: He waives the fine and leaves his flashlight.

options.label: Let him in to talk
options.outcome: He eats a can "as a courtesy" and leaves a copy of the bylaws.

exterior_modification.setup: The HOA president is at the hatch. He says it breaks the neighbourhood guidelines.
exterior_modification.title: Exterior Modification

options.label: Check the signs chapter three lists
options.outcome: Clear, odourless, no sheen. Two bottles, filled with confidence.

options.label: Fill everything and hope
options.outcome: Three bottles. The hope part is ongoing.

options.label: Leave it
options.outcome: By tomorrow the street has drunk it all.

fizzing_main.setup: Water is bubbling up from a broken main two streets over. It looks clean. It might even be.
fizzing_main.title: Broken Main

options.label: Boil it the way chapter one says
options.outcome: It takes all afternoon and most of the patience. One bottle, safe.

options.label: Drink it as it is
options.outcome: Two bottles' worth. {subject} drank first and is now sick.

options.label: Leave it
options.outcome: It's still fizzing on day 14. Nobody asks why.

fizzy_rain.setup: The gutter barrel filled overnight. The water is grey and faintly fizzing.
fizzy_rain.title: Fizzy Rain

options.label: Spray everything
options.outcome: The shelter smells like a summer evening. The fleas disagree, briefly.

options.label: Scratch and bear it
options.outcome: Three itchy days. Everyone's temper shortens.

options.label: Wash everyone in drinking water
options.outcome: Clean people, clean dog, a lot less water.

fleas.setup: Everyone is scratching. The dog looks innocent, which is suspicious.
fleas.title: Fleas

options.label: De-flea him and let him in
options.outcome: A clean dog. Everyone feels better than they have in days.

options.label: Feed him and send him off
options.outcome: He eats the whole can and trots off, looking pleased with himself.

options.label: Let him in as he is
options.outcome: Everyone's spirits lift. The fleas arrive tomorrow.

good_boy.setup: A retriever scratches at the hatch. His smart collar is still pinging an owner who stopped checking.
good_boy.title: Good Boy

options.label: Take it and let him in
options.outcome: He stays. The medkit has only been chewed a little.

options.label: Take it and send him off
options.outcome: He leaves. Nobody says anything for a while.

good_boy_returns.setup: The retriever is back at dawn, dragging a medkit by its strap.
good_boy_returns.title: Good Boy, Again

options.label: Lever it open
options.outcome: A long creak, a short bang, and daylight.

then.why: the hatch gave all at once

options.label: Everyone push together
options.outcome: On three. Then on three again. Then it moves.

options.label: Wait for it to settle
options.outcome: It shifts by itself the next evening. Nobody went anywhere in between.

jammed.setup: The hatch won't open. Something heavy shifted onto it in the night.
jammed.title: Jammed

options.label: Work by torchlight
options.outcome: Two batteries of courage, rationed carefully.

then.why: a shin met a shelf in the dark

options.label: Wait it out in the dark
options.outcome: Everyone learns the shelter by touch. Some lessons leave marks.

options.label: Burn the emergency candle
options.outcome: One candle, one evening, one very long night after it.

lights_out.setup: The shelter light flickers and dies. The battery is done, and the dark is very complete.
lights_out.title: Lights Out

options.label: Break the lock
options.outcome: Two bottles and a can. The sign was telling the truth.

then.why: the shed door gave all at once

options.label: Pry it by hand
options.outcome: The door gives eventually. One can, and some splinters.

options.label: Leave it
options.outcome: Somebody else's emergency.

locked_shed.setup: Behind {place} there's a garden shed with a padlock and a hand-painted EMERGENCY sign.
locked_shed.title: The Shed

options.label: Dig through it
options.outcome: Under the hoodies: something to pass the time.

options.label: Try the nurse's office
options.outcome: The office is at the end of a long, dusty corridor.

lost_and_found.setup: The lost-and-found box is still outside the office at {place}. It's mostly hoodies. Mostly.
lost_and_found.title: Lost and Found

options.label: Pack the pantry
options.outcome: Three cans and a bottle. The plastic fruit stays.

options.label: Fill your pockets
options.outcome: One can, and a brochure about the clubhouse.

options.label: Try the realtor's lockbox
options.outcome: The code is 1234. Inside: keys to this house. {name} lingered too long in the dust.

model_home.setup: Near {place}, a staged show home has plastic fruit and a real pantry.
model_home.title: Model Home

options.label: Signal him to keep moving
options.outcome: He flashes back "SORRY" and leaves a can by the hatch.

options.label: Lock up and wait
options.outcome: He tries the hatch twice and moves on. The lock holds.

options.label: Do nothing
options.outcome: He visits tonight. A padlock would have stopped him.

motion_detected.setup: A stranger with a crowbar is checking houses. The doorbell camera upstairs keeps announcing him.
motion_detected.title: Motion Detected

options.label: Take it inside
options.outcome: The drawing goes up by the radio. The water goes on the shelf.

options.label: Leave the water for someone else
options.outcome: You keep the drawing. Someone else gets the water.

neighbour_thanks.setup: A bag hangs from the hatch handle. Inside: water, and a crayon drawing of your hatch.
neighbour_thanks.title: A Note Under the Hatch

options.label: Send a medkit back with them
options.outcome: The runner writes the family's name at the top of the page.

options.label: Send two cans instead
options.outcome: "Food works too." The name goes on the list.

options.label: Say there's nothing to spare
options.outcome: The runner nods and checks the next house.

neighbourhood_1_medicine.setup: A runner from {place} has a list. The shelter there is short of medicine and takes families who help.
neighbourhood_1_medicine.title: A Runner From {place}

options.label: Send a medkit
options.outcome: "That'll do it." The name goes on the list.

options.label: Send a bottle of water
options.outcome: Water is always welcome. The name goes on the list.

options.label: Send them away
options.outcome: The runner doesn't come back after that.

neighbourhood_1_retry.setup: The runner from {place} tries once more. Anything to show the family will pull its weight.
neighbourhood_1_retry.title: The Runner Comes Back

effects.what: agreed a channel with the shelter

options.label: Agree a radio channel
options.outcome: Channel nine at dusk, written on two hands this time.

options.label: Tie a cloth to the hatch when you're ready
options.outcome: A strip of bedsheet, tied to the handle. It might be seen.

options.label: Shrug
options.outcome: "Then we'll find you," the runner says, without much hope.

neighbourhood_2_retry.setup: "We tried knocking. Nobody heard. Is there any other way to reach you?"
neighbourhood_2_retry.title: Any Way to Reach You

effects.what: agreed a channel with the shelter

options.label: Agree a radio channel
options.outcome: Channel nine, at dusk. The runner writes it on her hand.

options.label: Agree a light signal
options.outcome: Two long, one short. They practise it once, laughing.

options.label: Tell them to just knock
options.outcome: "We'll try," she says, in the voice people use for maybe.

neighbourhood_2_signal.setup: The runner is back. {place} wants a way to reach the family when the escort is ready.
neighbourhood_2_signal.title: How to Reach You

options.label: Find another route on the map
options.outcome: Through the school field and along the creek. Longer, quieter.

options.label: Walk a route yourself and report back
options.outcome: {name} walks three blocks and back, counting doors.

options.label: Tell them you can't help
options.outcome: The runner folds up the plan and leaves.

neighbourhood_3_retry.setup: The escort's first route was blocked. The runner asks for another way round.
neighbourhood_3_retry.title: A Safer Street

options.label: Mark a route on the map
options.outcome: A pencil line through back streets and a park. It looks almost easy.

options.label: Draw it from memory
options.outcome: The drawing has confident arrows and one street that may not exist.

options.label: Admit nobody knows the area
options.outcome: They'll scout it themselves. It will take a while.

neighbourhood_3_route.setup: The escort needs a route that avoids the worst streets. The runner asks if anyone knows one.
neighbourhood_3_route.title: The Long Way Round

options.label: Pack a bottle
options.outcome: A bottle by the hatch, labelled in marker.

options.label: Pack a can instead
options.outcome: A can of {food_label}, which will have to do.

options.label: There's nothing left
options.outcome: The runner nods. They've heard it before.

neighbourhood_4_retry.setup: "Last chance before the escort sets out. Anything for the walk?"
neighbourhood_4_retry.title: Supplies for the Road

options.label: Pack a bottle for the walk
options.outcome: One bottle, packed by the hatch, untouchable.

options.label: Pack the last loose rations
options.outcome: Two rations in a jar with a lid that mostly fits.

options.label: Say there's none to spare
options.outcome: "Then we wait for rain," the runner says.

neighbourhood_4_water.setup: The escort will be on foot for hours. They ask the family to bring water for the walk.
neighbourhood_4_water.title: Water for the Walk

options.label: Go with them
options.outcome: The family climbs out into grey light and walks, together, the long way round.

options.label: Ask them to come back tomorrow
options.outcome: They look at each other, then at the list. "We'll try."

neighbourhood_5_escort.setup: Two volunteers with armbands are at the hatch. One of them has the list with the family's name.
neighbourhood_5_escort.title: The Escort

options.label: Go with them
options.outcome: The family leaves the hatch open behind them, for whoever comes next.

options.label: Stay
options.outcome: They leave a bag of rice and the list, with the name crossed out.

neighbourhood_5_retry.setup: The two volunteers are back at the hatch. "Today, or not at all. We can't keep coming."
neighbourhood_5_retry.title: The Escort Returns

options.label: Give her the medkit
options.outcome: She doesn't say anything. She doesn't need to.

options.label: Give her advice and water
options.outcome: Cool cloths, small sips, watch the temperature. Two rations go with her.

options.label: Say there's nothing
options.outcome: She thanks you anyway, which is worse.

neighbours_daughter.setup: A neighbour is at the hatch. Her daughter has a fever, and she has tried every house on the street.
neighbours_daughter.title: The Neighbour's Daughter

effects.what: fetched the vacuum through the dust

options.label: Go out and get it
options.outcome: It docks by the radio and hums. Somehow that helps.

options.label: Name it and let it be
options.outcome: It's called Gerald now. Someone cries a little when the bumping stops.

options.label: Ignore it
options.outcome: Nobody sleeps.

night_shift.setup: At 2 a.m. something bumps the hatch in a slow, patient pattern. It's the robot vacuum, still cleaning ash off the lawn.
night_shift.title: Night Shift

options.label: Let them play until they drop off
options.outcome: Level four, then level five, then snoring.

options.label: Teach them a slow card game
options.outcome: The rules change every hand. Everybody wins eventually, then sleeps.

options.label: Tell stories until morning
options.outcome: {name} runs out of stories at four a.m. and starts inventing them.

nobody_sleeps.setup: {subject} hasn't slept in two nights. Every noise upstairs is the hatch opening.
nobody_sleeps.title: Nobody Sleeps

options.label: Try the radio instead
options.outcome: A broadcast names a supply drop at {nearest_school}. Worth a trip.

options.label: Let them keep trying
options.outcome: One text arrives: "Your order has shipped." {subject} took some dust for it.

options.label: Take the phone
options.outcome: {subject} sulks in the corner. The phone goes in a drawer.

one_bar.setup: {subject} keeps climbing the ladder, holding a phone up to the sky.
one_bar.title: One Bar

options.label: Open it by hand
options.outcome: Two cans and a bottle. The fridge is now a cabinet.

options.label: Look up the hard reset
options.outcome: Factory settings restored. Two cans, and a chirpy welcome tune.

options.label: Wait for the update
options.outcome: The progress bar says 2%. It has said 2% for an hour.

pending_update.setup: The smart fridge upstairs has locked itself to install an update. There's food inside.
pending_update.title: Pending Update

options.label: Sign the sheet and take a share
options.outcome: One can, signed for in neat capitals.

options.label: Take everything
options.outcome: Three cans. {name} doesn't look at the sign-in sheet on the way out.

pew_pantry.setup: Behind {place}'s hall there's a food pantry, half-sorted, with a sign-in sheet nobody signed.
pew_pantry.title: The Pantry Under the Stairs

options.label: Make them leave
options.outcome: They leave without arguing. They leave a medkit, too.

options.label: Wait them out
options.outcome: They take their time. By the time they leave, so has the medicine.

then.text: {name} got a medkit and got out.

options.label: Sneak to the back shelves
options.outcome: {name} goes low along the back aisle.

pharmacy_looters.setup: Two people are already inside {place}, filling bags. They haven't seen {name} yet.
pharmacy_looters.title: Already Inside

else.text: They scatter, then come back to a safer corner.

options.label: Fire a warning shot
options.outcome: The notebooks go away fast.

else.text: They note the lock down too.

options.label: Add a second lock where they can see it
options.outcome: A shiny padlock, on display. Security theatre, but theatre works sometimes.

options.label: Stay quiet
options.outcome: They write for an hour and leave. Nobody sleeps well.

scouts.setup: Two figures on the corner are watching the hatch and writing things down.
scouts.title: Scouts

options.label: Spray the corners
options.outcome: The corners are quiet again. The can is empty.

options.label: Pick them out by hand
options.outcome: A long, fiddly afternoon. Two rations are past saving.

options.label: Drink around them
options.outcome: It's protein, someone says. Nobody laughs.

second_wave.setup: The ants are back, and they've brought relatives. They're in the water this time.
second_wave.title: Second Wave

options.label: Shoot it down
options.outcome: It drops a parcel: two cans and a satisfaction survey.

options.label: Thumbprint it
options.outcome: Logged as "Delivered." {name} stood a long minute in the dust for it.

options.label: Ignore it
options.outcome: It beeps politely until sundown. Nobody sleeps much.

signature_required.setup: A delivery drone hovers at the hatch, demanding a signature for the house upstairs.
signature_required.title: Signature Required

options.label: Watch the vent all night, masked
options.outcome: {name} keeps the vent clear until dawn and sleeps through lunch.

options.label: Seal the vent and sweat it out
options.outcome: It gets hot. Everyone drinks more than they should.

options.label: Hope it passes
options.outcome: The smoke passes. Some of it stays in someone's chest.

smoke_on_the_street.setup: A house down the street is burning. The smoke is rolling toward the vent.
smoke_on_the_street.title: Smoke on the Street

options.label: Let them tinker
options.outcome: Screws on the table, solder smoke, then a voice reading the fallout map.

options.label: Crank it all night instead
options.outcome: {subject} cranks until the small hours and hears mostly weather.

options.label: Leave it alone
options.outcome: The radio stays in one piece. So does the argument.

static_hour.setup: {subject} wants to take the back off the radio to pull in a stronger station.
static_hour.title: Static Hour

options.label: Search the back with the light
options.outcome: A shrink-wrapped pallet of water, forgotten behind the ice cream.

then.why: a shelf edge in the dark

options.label: Feel around in the dark
options.outcome: One bottle, found by touch.

options.label: Leave it
options.outcome: The freezer keeps its secrets.

station_freezer.setup: The gas station's walk-in freezer is dark and silent. Something inside is still sealed.
station_freezer.title: The Walk-In

options.label: Take the sack
options.outcome: A can and a bottle. They're gone before anyone can say thanks.

options.label: Invite them to eat
options.outcome: The shelter is loud for an hour. It's a good loud.

stranger_returns.setup: The teenager is back with a friend and a sack. "For the water," they say.
stranger_returns.title: Paid Back

options.label: Open a can of {food_label} for her
options.outcome: She eats, inspects everyone, and takes the warmest spot. She lives here now.

options.label: Let her in
options.outcome: She finds the food shelf before anyone shows her where it is.

options.label: Shoo her off
options.outcome: She leaves slowly, so everyone can watch.

stray_cat.setup: A thin cat is sitting on the hatch, watching the vent like it owes her money.
stray_cat.title: Whiskers at the Vent

options.label: Trade rounds for water
options.outcome: Ammunition is the local currency. Two bottles, no change given.

options.label: Haul a load home
options.outcome: Two cans, rolled home on squeaky wheels.

options.label: Watch from the hatch
options.outcome: Somebody waves. Somebody else notices.

swap_meet.setup: People have set up tables at the corner, trading under umbrellas. Someone is selling water by the cup.
swap_meet.title: Swap Meet

options.label: Give extra water all day
options.outcome: A bottle, a sip at a time, all day.

options.label: Treat it properly
options.outcome: Antibiotics, a cold cloth, and sleep. {subject} is through the worst.

options.label: Let the fever run
options.outcome: A long night. The fever is still there in the morning.

sweating_it_out.setup: {subject}'s fever spiked overnight. The sheets are soaked, and they keep asking for water.
sweating_it_out.title: Sweating It Out

options.label: Trade the game console
options.outcome: She checks the battery, nods, and leaves two cans. Somebody's save file goes with her.

options.label: Trade the flashlight
options.outcome: One can for one flashlight. She seems to have a lot of flashlights.

options.label: Decline
options.outcome: She shrugs and moves on. The cans move on with her.

the_collector.setup: A woman in a clean coat is trading food for "things that still turn on".
the_collector.title: The Collector

options.label: Give him a box
options.outcome: He leaves a medkit from his truck and a promise to keep an eye out.

options.label: Wish him luck
options.outcome: He tips an imaginary hat and walks on.

effects.why: the deputy told everyone about the hatch

options.label: Tell him to move along
options.outcome: He mutters about it to anyone who'll listen.

the_deputy.setup: A neighbour in an old sheriff's jacket has a rifle and no rounds. He says he's keeping the street safe.
the_deputy.title: The Deputy

options.label: Chain the hatch from inside
options.outcome: The chain rattles every time the wind blows. That's the point.

options.label: Paint over it
options.outcome: Grey paint over red paint. The hatch looks abandoned again.

options.label: Leave it
options.outcome: Everyone knows it's there. Nobody looks at the hatch.

the_tag.setup: Someone spray-painted a symbol on the hatch overnight. It isn't a friendly symbol.
the_tag.title: The Tag

options.label: Give them a bottle
options.outcome: They drink half and save half, very carefully.

options.label: Give them a can instead
options.outcome: It isn't what they asked for. They eat it anyway, sitting on the step.

options.label: Say there's nothing to spare
options.outcome: They nod and walk on. Nobody mentions them again, which says enough.

thirsty.setup: A teenager is sitting by the hatch, very still. They ask, politely, for water.
thirsty.title: Thirsty

options.label: Go through the stockroom
options.outcome: The floor plan shows a stockroom door. One can and one bottle, quietly.

options.label: Grab and run
options.outcome: The noise draws two scavengers. {name} gets out, but not cleanly.

options.label: Scan everything politely
options.outcome: Forty minutes later: one can and a receipt nobody asked for.

unexpected_item.setup: At {place}, the self-checkouts are on backup power and complain every time {name} moves.
unexpected_item.title: Unexpected Item

options.label: Spray the shelf
options.outcome: The shelf is clear. The smell lingers longer than the bugs did.

options.label: Swat them with the manual
options.outcome: Chapter four is about pests. It's also heavy.

options.label: Live with them
options.outcome: They share the food. They do not share well.

uninvited.setup: Something small and numerous has found the food shelf.
uninvited.title: Uninvited

options.label: Eat the least spoiled can
options.outcome: Two rations of something. {name} regrets it by evening.

options.label: Leave it all up there
options.outcome: The fridge plays a little song of thanks.

update_complete.setup: The fridge upstairs chimes. The update finished. Everything inside has spoiled.
update_complete.title: Update Complete!

effects.what: traded for a bottle of water

options.label: Trade a box of rounds
options.outcome: He counts the rounds twice and hands over a bottle.

effects.what: traded for a bottle of water

options.label: Trade the cards
options.outcome: "Haven't played in years," he says, already shuffling.

options.label: Send him away
options.outcome: He wheels off, bottles clinking. Everyone watches them go.

water_man.setup: A man with a shopping cart of bottled water knocks. He doesn't take cash, but he's open to offers.
water_man.title: The Water Man
